criteria.description: filterProducts filters by name: only products whose name contains the trimmed, case-insensitive search term are returned. An empty or whitespace-only search term matches all products.

criteria.description: filterProducts filters by category: only products whose category exactly equals filters.category are returned. When filters.category is 'All', no category filter is applied and all products are returned.
criteria.evidence: filtering.test.tsx — 3 tests passed. Test suite reported: '✓ tests/filtering.test.tsx (3 tests) 165ms'. The 'filters products by category' test passed as part of this suite.

criteria.description: filterProducts filters by in-stock status: when filters.inStockOnly is true, only products where inStock === true are returned. When filters.inStockOnly is false, all products are returned regardless of stock status.

criteria.description: In App.tsx, the handler passed to FilterPanel as onChange calls both setFilters(nextFilters) and setPage(1). The raw setFilters must not be passed directly.
criteria.evidence: Code inspection of App.tsx line 33: onChange={(nextFilters) => { setFilters(nextFilters); setPage(1); }} — a wrapper function (not setFilters itself) is passed; its body contains both setFilters(nextFilters) and setPage(1).

criteria.description: In App.tsx, the handler passed to SortSelect as onChange calls both setFilters(prev => ({ ...prev, sortBy })) and setPage(1). The current partial wrapper omits setPage(1).
criteria.evidence: Code inspection of App.tsx line 38: onChange={(sortBy) => { setFilters((prev) => ({ ...prev, sortBy })); setPage(1); }} — the wrapper body contains setPage(1) in addition to the setFilters call.
